We shipped a big content push. 🎉

## Interactive Labs: 15 → 28
Twelve new [Interactive Labs](https://www.impactmojo.in/labs/) across three new tracks (Research & Methods, Governance & Digital, Climate & Environment):

- Budget & Fiscal Analysis
- Climate Risk & Adaptation
- Conflict-Sensitive Programming
- Data Feminism & Intersectional Analysis
- Digital Public Infrastructure
- Ethics & Research Integrity
- Grant Writing & Proposal
- Participatory Methods
- Policy Brief Writing
- Stakeholder Mapping & Power Analysis
- Survey Design
- Systems Thinking & Complexity

## New: run R and Python in your browser
[R & Python for Development](https://www.impactmojo.in/labs/r-python-dev.html) teaches both languages from zero with **real code running in the browser** via WebR + Pyodide — no install.

All free, browser-based, mobile-friendly, dark/light theme.
